abstract.text: Fit preprocessing on training observations, apply the fitted preprocessing to held-out observations, and pass prepared data directly to PCA. PCA returns component scores with feature names and original row positions.

content.text: Handle invalid input and model state

inlineContent.text: Fitting requires at least one observation and feature, rectangular rows, finite values, and a component count no greater than the smaller input dimension. Prepared missing entries are rejected. Exporting them to a matrix as NaNs does not make them valid PCA input. GPU fitting also rejects Double values that overflow Float conversion before calling the native solver.
Prepared projection requires finite inputs and rejects nonfinite scores. A zero-row prepared input with matching feature names returns zero-row score columns. Legacy
and
retain their empty-input errors. Legacy nested transforms retain NaN propagation. The existing dataframe
convenience method retains its missing-to-zero extraction behavior.
A failed fit leaves the previous fitted state intact.

performs an ordinary successful fit followed by projection. A later projection failure does not roll back that successful fit. Serialize related fit and transform calls on a shared model when they must use one particular fit.

Caller-held inputs, solver workspace, scores, and MLX allocations have separate lifetimes. PCA does not impose an RSS cap. Use the existing memory-admission facilities with an estimate covering the complete operation when your application requires admission control.

abstract.text: Principal component analysis with explicit CPU solver and device choices.
Prepared inputs retain feature identity and return named, provenance-preserving scores.
